meta.promptText: India mein shaadi ke liye budget mein online konsi sarees kharidun?

response.text:
Shaadi ke liye **budget mein** online ye saree options best rahenge:

- **Banarasi silk/soft silk:** Reception ya wedding guest look ke liye royal; ₹600–₹1,500 ke budget mein options mil sakte hain. Meesho par Banarasi silk sarees lagbhag ₹639 se listed hain.[2]
- **Kanjeevaram-style silk saree:** Traditional look ke liye, lekin “pure silk” ke bajay silk-blend/jacquard check karein; budget options ₹300–₹1,000 ke aas-paas milte hain.[2]
- **Georgette saree with sequin work:** Sangeet ya reception ke liye lightweight aur glamorous; ₹500–₹1,200 ka budget rakhein.
- **Organza saree:** Elegant, modern look ke liye; pastel pink, lavender, mint ya peach shades achhe lagenge.
- **Chiffon/crepe saree:** Comfortable aur repeat-wear option; printed ya light-embroidery designs ₹300–₹800 mein mil sakte hain.[3]
- **Silk-blend embroidered saree:** Thodi premium finish chahiye to Libas par sale mein options ₹759–₹1,259 ke aas-paas listed hain.[6]
- **Paithani-style cotton silk:** Traditional Maharashtrian look ke liye; budget listings ₹481 ke aas-paas bhi milti hain.[5]

## Budget ke hisaab se meri recommendation

| Budget | Best choice |
|---|---|
| ₹300–₹600 | Georgette, chiffon, printed silk-blend |
| ₹600–₹1,200 | Banarasi-style, organza, embroidered silk-blend |
| ₹1,200–₹2,000 | Better-quality silk-blend ya heavy reception saree |
| ₹2,000–₹5,000 | Premium woven silk-blend ya designer-style saree |

**Sabse safe purchase:** ₹700–₹1,200 ki **silk-blend Banarasi ya embroidered georgette saree**, jisme blouse piece included ho. Meesho par wedding sarees ₹149 se shuru hone aur kai options ₹299 se kam hone ka listing data milta hai, lekin bahut low-price products mein fabric aur finishing reviews se zaroor verify karein.[2]

Kharidne se pehle **customer photos, blouse-piece details, saree length, return policy aur delivery date** check karein—shaadi ke liye delivery kam se kam 7–10 din pehle honi chahiye.
